summary: Adds a proposed Challenge to the Pilot Designer (OWNER-PILOT-DESIGNER-ROUTE-01, slice 2). It follows the client's draft, suggests a launch-portfolio family from the client's own words and physics, and for a family with exam-design evidence (battery) proposes that family's tested settings, each with its reason and the measured table behind it, relayed verbatim from the exam-design campaign result. Conditions the client omitted are proposed from the tested design and labelled; ranges outside the tested design are flagged; units are never converted. A family without evidence proposes no setting and no cost. Deterministic, in the browser, not sent to the guidance provider; it registers, qualifies, prices and approves nothing.
